findings.title: Direct Git-Sourced Dependency 'grunt-if' (Mutable Branch)
findings.explanation: Package 'grunt-if' is sourced directly from a Git repository ('https://github.com/binarymist/grunt-if/tarball/master') rather than a registered package registry. The specification references a mutable branch, which poses reproducibility and upstream drift risks. However, if package-lock.json resolves this reference to an immutable commit hash or integrity checksum, the local installation is frozen.
findings.technical_explanation: Package 'grunt-if' is sourced directly from a Git repository ('https://github.com/binarymist/grunt-if/tarball/master') rather than a registered package registry. The specification references a mutable branch, which poses reproducibility and upstream drift risks. However, if package-lock.json resolves this reference to an immutable commit hash or integrity checksum, the local installation is frozen.
findings.potential_impact: Minimal risk when pinned to full commit SHA; mutable branches or tags can introduce upstream changes between builds if lockfile is regenerated.
findings.recommended_action: Pin Git dependencies to full 40-character commit SHAs or vendor with subresource integrity digests.
